subject.title: Dashboard: new data-binding kinds — stream, command, computed

question: Should dashboard bindings include allowlisted periodic command execution, or should command execution be split into a separate security-reviewed design after stream and computed bindings?
rationale: Automation cannot choose the product and security boundary for a feature that turns dashboard data resolution into recurring command execution, especially before the dashboard substrate is accepted.

options.title: Split Command Security Design
options.body: Proceed with stream and computed binding design only after the substrate lands, and require a separate maintainer-approved proposal for command execution.

options.title: Approve All Binding Kinds Together
options.body: Accept stream, computed, and command bindings as one roadmap feature with full allowlist, permission, and proof requirements.

options.title: Defer Apps-Layer Bindings
options.body: Keep the issue open but pause implementation until maintainers decide whether this dashboard apps layer belongs in bundled OpenClaw.

recommendation.title: Split Command Security Design
recommendation.body: Proceed with stream and computed binding design only after the substrate lands, and require a separate maintainer-approved proposal for command execution.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current-main ownership signal is the recently merged Control UI plugin-tab seam and Logbook precedent this dashboard work reuses.
